turns.question: Which customer country brought in the most revenue per buying customer in September 2026, and how much per customer?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-customer metric, and I may not divide figures myself, so I can't name the top country or a per-customer amount. For 1-30 September 2026 it gives revenue (EUR) and active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) by customer country: DE 2,665.50 EUR / 2; GB 2,634.00 EUR / 2; NL 2,408.00 EUR / 2; TR 2,412.00 EUR / 2; FR 1,241.00 EUR / 1; US 1,222.25 EUR / 1. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
